## VOLUME 03, BATCH 0004 — CHARACTER STATE AFTER CHAPTER 140, Wednesday 29 April 2015

**Read with the "VOLUME 03, BATCH 0004" blocks at the end of `state/continuity.md` and `state/open-threads.md`. Those carry the canon. This carries only what moved, and what may not be moved back.**

- **JONAS MERCER, 32.** Stage 2, a rule mender, a transfer steward in practice and not in title. LAST WORKING SYSTEM ADMINISTRATOR, CITY OF NACRE — civic standing, no grade, no department, no probation, not subject to review, released by no person. **HE HAS ASKED EXACTLY ONE QUESTION IN THE WHOLE OF CHAPTERS 131–140 — six words, in a corridor, on the evening of 25 March — AND HE HAS NOW ASKED NO QUESTION OF ANYBODY SINCE THE TWENTY-FIFTH OF FEBRUARY 2015.** He is two men findable because of things he said in rooms, and a third thing he did not start, and he cannot unmake any of them, and **HE DID NOT MAKE A FOURTH IN THIS BATCH, AND HE CAME WITHIN ONE CORRIDOR OF MAKING ONE AND DID NOT, AND THE REASON IS EIGHT WORDS: I AM THE PERSON WHO MADE IT CHEAP.** **WHAT HE SAID OUT LOUD IN A ROOM IN DAYLIGHT IN NINE MONTHS, AND NOTHING ELSE:** 28 January, five items about what a service floor is made of, not to be restated as a list and not to go on a wall · 13 March, one sentence about what it costs, not to be restated · **27 April 2015, one sentence about what it is for: IT IS FOR THE PEOPLE THE BOROUGH CANNOT COUNT.** **HE HAS DECLINED A QUESTION TWICE IN A ROOM — he will not answer what a thing is made of without saying what it costs, and he will not answer what a thing costs without saying what a person can afford it — AND ON 27 APRIL HE DECLINED THE THIRD ONE AS ASKED AND PUT ANOTHER IN PLACE OF IT AND ANSWERED THAT, and he is not going to say any of the three a fourth time.** **HE REFUSED OUT LOUD, IN A SHOP, TWICE, NOT TO GO AND FIND SOMEBODY, AND BOTH REFUSALS STOOD AND NEITHER WAS REVERSED: the man of forty-eight, and the man who turns the bucket on the board of forty slots.** **HE TRIED THREE WAYS IN ABOUT NINE MINUTES TO STOP A PORTER NOTICING A PATTERN IN HIS OWN ABSENCES AND ALL THREE WERE CLOSED AND HE STOPPED NOTHING, and the cost was that a correct thing was going to happen in a building and he was the only person he knew of who could see it happening.** **HE STOOD AT A WALL ON 24 APRIL WHILE A STRANGER ASKED THE COUNTER WHETHER HE WAS ON A LIST, AND SAID NOTHING, AND THERE WAS NO POINT AT WHICH HE COULD HAVE SAID ANYTHING.** **HE OPENED NOTHING IN VOLUME 03 AFTER 28 JANUARY, INCLUDING THE HOUR BETWEEN SIX AND SEVEN, AND HE HAS A SPENT CLAIM TO A DOOR.** **HE IS FOUR HUNDRED YARDS AWAY, ON PURPOSE, AND FOUR HUNDRED YARDS IS NOT AN ANSWER EITHER, BECAUSE A PLACE A MAN GOES TO IS THE FIRST HALF OF A SCHEDULE, AND FROM FOUR HUNDRED YARDS YOU CANNOT TELL WHETHER A DOOR IS OPEN OR SHUT, AND THAT IS THE CORRECT AMOUNT OF EVIDENCE.** **AND THE THING THIS BATCH ENDED ON, WHICH IS ABOUT HIM AND IS THE FIRST TIME: HE HAS BEEN DOING IT FOR NOTHING FOR FOUR MONTHS AND THE ENTIRE PRODUCT IS THAT TWO TIRED MEN COULD SAY THAT HE WAS THERE, and he would rather be that than a name on a list, AND THAT IS NOT A PRINCIPLE, IT IS A PRICE, and it has been said once, on the thirteenth of April, to one woman, and he came in again on 24 April with the same thing in his mouth and did not say it, and he is not going to ask her again and he is not going to anybody else with it and NOBODY IS GOING TO BE TOLD.** He has a pad, and one page of it in a shop that goes nowhere holds a sentence a records supervisor said out loud on 8 April, and **nobody may open that pad and nobody may ask what is in it.** He is not on the agenda, not a party, not a member, not a departmental officer, may not chair anything, and **there is no chair of that body at all and there never was.**

- **NINA CALDER, about fifty, nineteen years in that office, designing lists since 1999, comes down to the ground-floor counter at about ten and at about three because nobody has ever told her to and nobody could.** **THE WOMAN WHO KEEPS THE MINUTES IS THE SAME PERSON WHO STANDS AT THAT COUNTER, AND THAT IS NOW CANON, AND JONAS MERCER TOOK TEN WEEKS TO SEE IT BECAUSE HE HAD BEEN ASSUMING THERE WAS A BOX THAT SAID SO. There is no box: there is a sheet that says *minute taken by* and a name in it, and that is the only name-box on the whole of the ground floor, and the sheet is the minute until about four o'clock and after that it is only a sheet, and she is the only person in this city who can end a minute by picking one up and putting it down, and a box that tied the minute to the counter would be a rota with one name in it and the name would be hers.** **ON WEDNESDAY 8 APRIL 2015, IN DAYLIGHT, IN A ROOM WITH ABOUT ELEVEN PEOPLE IN IT, SHE SAID ONE SENTENCE ABOUT HERSELF AND NOBODY ASKED HER AND IT TOOK ABOUT ELEVEN SECONDS: I DECIDE IT, AND THERE IS NOBODY I AM ALLOWED TO ASK WHETHER I HAVE DECIDED IT RIGHT, AND THAT IS THE WHOLE OF IT, AND I HAVE HAD THAT FOR NINETEEN YEARS. SHE SAID IT TO THE ROOM AND NOT TO HIM, BECAUSE A SENTENCE SAID TO ONE PERSON IN A CORRIDOR IS A THING TWO PEOPLE KNOW AND CAN BE USED, AND THERE IS NO BOX ON A ROOM.** The reason she gave for giving it, about nine seconds: he has had a pen since 4 September and has been writing down why other people say no for nine months and nobody in this city has ever once asked him for one of his. **THAT SENTENCE IS NOW IN ABOUT ELEVEN PEOPLE AND IN NO DOCUMENT, AND IT IS PRECISELY THE THING SHE REFUSED ON 2 JANUARY, AND IT HAS HAPPENED ANYWAY, AND IT WAS NOT ANYBODY'S FAULT, AND SHE WENT INTO THAT ROOM ON PURPOSE.** **NOBODY MAY ASK HER A QUESTION ABOUT IT AFTERWARDS. HE DID NOT ASK HER WHETHER SHE WAS GOING TO PUT IT IN THE MINUTE AND SHE DID NOT OFFER, AND SHE WILL NOT.** It is in one hand in a pad in a shop that goes nowhere, which is the first time anything she has said has gone anywhere at all, and she knew that and let it, and she said `do not come back and tell me what you did with it`. **HER SEVEN REFUSALS STAND AND SHE DID NOT ADD TO IT, AND NOTHING SHE SAID IN THIS BATCH WAS A REFUSAL AND NOTHING IN THIS BATCH WAS A TWELFTH.** She has not given a count to anybody. She has not read the card in the slot and is not going to. She has not opened the letter of 18 February in front of a second person and has told nobody it is there, and it has been there sixty-eight days, and **she knows she is going to be proved right about a register that grows when nobody is hurt, and it is going to be about the shelf and not about the bulb, and she does not know that, and Jonas Mercer does, and is not going to tell her, because if he told her she would be the woman who was warned.** Her nine words stand: a number of what a counter does is a level of service, and the day a floor has a level of service somebody can cut it. **THE DRAWER IS NOT A FILE. She keeps a copy of every state she has ever written, and a man walks out with a state in a pocket, and the two pieces of paper are the same state about a day and neither of them is a record of the other, and that is why the drift works and why the drawer is going to be somebody's evidence one day. She has given no count to anybody and nobody can ask her for one. AND THERE IS ONE RECORDS SUPERVISOR IN THIS ACCOUNT AND SHE IS HER: the woman of about fifty at the counter on the second floor who has been there eleven years is a different person, on the same floor and the same age, and the two have never been confused for each other in public.**

- **BEATRICE OSUNDE, about sixty, at the barrier end of that street for thirty-one years, oiling a bench.** **She did not improve the man at the forty-slot board and she did not tell him what to do about it, and she said once, about a list, that a man visible because water costs money and a man visible because a woman in a hall said a shape out loud in a room are not the same shape and are not the same man, and that if anyone ever writes a sentence putting them in the same list then the list is a list of people somebody can ring, and she has watched that happen to about four people in thirty-one years and is not going to watch it happen to a man who turns a bucket for nothing.** **SHE WAS TOLD, ON 13 APRIL, THAT A THING LIKE WHAT HE IS DOING HAS TO BE SAID TO SOMEBODY FOUR TIMES A DAY FOR A WEEK BEFORE IT HOLDS, AND SHE ANSWERED IT: four times a day for a week is for a thing you have to survive; nobody survives standing in a corridor; nobody has ever survived it; it is not a position, it is just a thing a man does until he is an old man who does it, and then it is a habit and then it is a rota, and there is no version of it where a man in his thirties has got a position at a bus turning head and a Sunday morning in it.** **AND ON 24 APRIL, WHEN HE CAME IN WITH THE SAME THING IN HIS MOUTH AND DID NOT SAY IT, SHE SAID: `The oil came in on Tuesday and the tin is by the door and I would like it moved before the weekend. And that is not the same conversation and I am telling you that it is not the same conversation so that you know I know it is not the same conversation.` AND SHE HAS TOLD HIM SHE IS NOT GOING TO BE ASKED TWICE AND THAT IF HE COMES IN ON A WEDNESDAY WITH THE SAME THING AGAIN IN A DIFFERENT COAT SHE SHALL PUT THE BROOM IN FRONT OF HIM.** **She still has not read the pad and has said four times over nine months that she is not going to, and she was not thanked for any of it and no character has thanked her and the refusal-to-be-thanked beat did not fire once in this batch.** And in April, the sentence she gave about a table in a kitchen: `In about four years it is not going to be you that it matters to, is it. It is going to be some poor devil of a frightened person in a kitchen, and somebody is going to put something on that table, and it is not going to be the bulb.` **The twelve words are hers and are unchanged: *being findable is not the same as being useful.***

- **BRAM OSEI, porter, Saint Orra west, the day bearer.** **HIS THURSDAY IS STILL REFUSED ON THE BOARD IN HIS OWN HANDWRITING WITH *no reason I can give* UNDER A *no reason given* IN SOMEBODY ELSE'S HAND, HE HAS ASKED TWICE THAT THE SECOND LINE NOT BE LOOKED AT, AND NOBODY LOOKED AT IT IN BATCH 0004 AND NOBODY IS GOING TO.** On Friday 3 April 2015, in a ground-floor corridor, in daylight, unasked, and without having been asked a question, **HE SAID: `You have not been down.`** Twenty-seven days after the seventh of March and twenty days after the fourteenth. **IT IS TRUE AND IT IS IN ONE PORTER'S EAR AND IT IS WORTH NOTHING, AND IT ESTABLISHED SOMETHING NOBODY HAD ESTABLISHED BEFORE: A PORTER IS A PERSON WHO CAN TELL THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A MAN WHO IS THERE AND A MAN WHO IS NOT — and it was established by a man noticing on his own.** Jonas Mercer tried three ways to stop it and could not stop it and did not tell him any of that and has not told him anything since and he has told nobody. He has said nothing since 2 March, has not been asked anything, and is not going to be. He is not on a rota, not on a board, not in any instrument in this city, and he is the reason a man of forty-eight has not been asked, and he is now the reason a man of thirty-two cannot know whether his absences are being noticed.

- **EMMANUEL OTIENO, 38.** Agency, ten years, four agencies in nine years and the same two in the last four. Nights at a depot, four to ten, and a second job on Fridays he does not talk about and there is nothing in Chapters 131–140 about the Fridays. Rents the top floor of a building on a road he has never seen the name of on any paper. **A daughter of nine who comes in on the left foot first and puts her shoes on wrong, and if the shoes are not by the door she does them on the pavement.** **HE GAVE THE METHOD TO THREE PEOPLE AND TOLD NOBODY AND WROTE NOTHING DOWN, AND HE WAS NOT TAUGHT IT AND NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH IS ABLE TO TELL HIM WHAT TO DO WITH IT: a woman of about thirty-one at the depot, four years, who asked him on a Tuesday in February how he knew a thing was true on a day and wrote nothing down either; a man of about fifty-five on the second floor of his building who does not work shifts and asked him in that kitchen on a Sunday in the middle of March why he was so calm about a landlord; and a man about thirty he met once in a queue outside a hospital in the middle of February, who had been at the same school in a different decade, and who has a daughter too, and who wrote a date on the back of his hand and asked him whether that counted, and it counted, and he did not tell him the half about a rent book and is not going to.** **HE HAS ALSO WORKED OUT THE FAR END OF IT, ALONE, WITH THE TAP RUNNING, AT THAT SINK IN FEBRUARY, AND TOLD NOBODY: in about four years somebody is going to write a form, it will be a good form, and the woman who hands it over will not have chosen to be in it and will not be able to be un-in it, and the wall is not the counter, the wall is the day somebody can say *we can only do eight today* and be entirely correct, and it will not be the man who said it, it will never be the man who said it, it will be the first person who is tired and honest.** A plastic wallet in the glovebox of a van he does not own, in a yard two streets away, and nobody in this borough can say how many pieces of paper are in it, and that is correct. **He did not open the glovebox on 25 March, and it is not a thing he is going to start doing, and the reason is that a man who opens a glovebox on a Wednesday afternoon is a man who is looking at it, and a man who is looking at it will open it again.** **THE DISCOVERY HAS TRAVELLED SIDEWAYS AND HAS REACHED A PLACE WITH A NAME ON IT AND HE DOES NOT KNOW AND CANNOT FIND OUT AND WAS NOT TOLD.** He is findable now, to three people and counting, and does not know it. He is not on any list. He was not helped and was not rescued and nobody gave him anything.

- **ABU BAKAYOKO, 58.** Twenty-six years at a stand at the top of the lowland market, five in the morning, a bucket, two urns and no drain, and a man he pays to empty them twice a day and has never once asked the name of, and a bowser and a man on the bowser paid on Fridays out of his own pocket. **HIS FIRST SLIP OF 26 JANUARY, FIVE NODES ON ONE SLIP, IS SEVEN WEEKS OLD AND IS IN AN INSIDE POCKET AND HAS NOT BEEN LOOKED AT SINCE THE DAY HE WROTE IT DOWN IN FRONT OF HER. HE CAME ON 2 FEBRUARY AND ON 13 FEBRUARY AND HAS NOT COME SINCE, AND IT IS A FRIDAY, AND IF HE COMES ON A FRIDAY FOR ANOTHER FOUR YEARS THAT IS NOT A MAN, THAT IS A ROTA WITH ONE NAME ON IT THAT NOBODY WROTE DOWN AND THAT NOBODY COULD WRITE DOWN. HE IS THE ONLY PERSON WHO COULD CORRECT ANYTHING HE WAS TOLD AND HE IS NOT COMING BACK AND THERE IS NO REASON HE WOULD.** His refusal of the sixth water point stands, is minuted, and nobody may ask him where it is. **He did not appear in a room in this batch and may not be made un-right.**

- **THE MAN OF ABOUT FIFTY-SIX WHO IS NOT A MEMBER.** **HE HAS NOW ASKED THREE QUESTIONS OF JONAS MERCER IN NINE MONTHS, ON 28 JANUARY, ON 13 MARCH, AND ON 27 APRIL 2015, AND HE HAS GOT THREE ANSWERS AND ALL THREE ARE IN PUBLIC MINUTES WITH NO NAMES IN THEM, AND NONE OF THE THREE HAS BEEN REPEATED AND NONE OF THE THREE HAS BEEN PLACED ON A WALL, AND THAT IS RECORDED IN THE MINUTE OF 27 APRIL AS ITSELF.** He did not apologise on any of the three occasions and did not say *may I* on any of them. **HE DID NOT ASK A FOURTH QUESTION, AND HE HAS FIVE WORDS IN BIRO ON THE BACK OF HIS LEFT HAND — IT IS NOT A LIST — AND NOBODY HAS EVER ASKED HIM WHAT IS ON HIS HAND AND NOBODY IS GOING TO.** He was the man who asked Jonas Mercer to chair on 3 December and was refused. He is not a member, did not come as a member, and is not on any list. He is the only person in nine months who has asked Jonas Mercer anything, and on 27 April he asked what the floor is for — that the purpose of the floor is people the borough cannot count — and put it to the room, and a room of eleven people standing sideways in a vestibule eleven feet by nine heard it, and about eleven of those people are the only record of it.

- **YOLANDA FOFANA, 54.** Unpaid and findable at a shopfront since 4 July, the only door in a building of thirty-one rented rooms. **SHE DID NOT APPEAR IN A ROOM IN THIS BATCH AND WAS NOT ASKED ANYTHING AND WAS NOT TOLD ANYTHING AND NOBODY IS GOING TO.** On 11 December, in a kitchen, she said she has not got an answer ready and is not going to get one ready in a room, and that it is the same refusal as the day after and the same reason and it stands, and it has not been improved on by anybody including him. **HER REFUSAL TO ANSWER THE DAY AFTER STANDS, TOMAS RENN'S QUESTION IS UNANSWERED AND IS STILL THE ENGINE, AND A QUESTION IS GOING TO BE PUT TO HER IN THE SPRING AND IT IS NOT GOING TO BE JONAS MERCER'S AND HE IS NOT GOING TO STOP IT AND HE IS NOT GOING TO BE IN THE ROOM, AND NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH IS ENTITLED TO MAKE HER GET AN ANSWER READY AND THERE IS NO INSTRUMENT IN THIS CITY BY WHICH ANYBODY COULD.** The ninth seat is not a chair, a veto, a job, a paid office, a rota, or anything anybody can be required to do, and there is no chair of that body at all, the eight did not learn what she is, and nobody in this batch noticed what she can do.

- **A WOMAN OF THIRTY-FOUR.** Was in a room on 3 December 2014 and has not been in one since. **WAS ASKED TWICE, IN DAYLIGHT, IN ROOMS, WITH PAPERS, AND DID NOT COME EITHER TIME, and nobody can make her come and nobody can even make anybody try, and there is no number in this borough for anybody to telephone and the reason is four words long: NOBODY OWNS THAT NUMBER.** She is a name in about eleven people and in no document. **JONAS MERCER DID NOT WRITE THE FOUR LINES AND NEVER DID AND HAS NEVER CLAIMED THEM; WHAT HE DID WAS SAY HER NAME OUT LOUD, ON WEDNESDAY 3 DECEMBER 2014, AT ABOUT TWENTY TO SEVEN IN THE EVENING, IN A ROOM WITH ABOUT ELEVEN PEOPLE IN IT, IN ABOUT NINE SECONDS, AND THE MINUTE SAYS THAT A NAME WAS STATED AND DOES NOT CONTAIN IT. THE FOUR LINES AT THE TOP OF THAT SHEET OF A4 ARE THE MINUTE-TAKER'S, IN BIRO, WRITTEN ON 21 JANUARY 2015 IN ABOUT FOUR MINUTES ON A SECOND SHEET THAT HAD NOTHING AT THE TOP OF IT.** Her letter of 28 November is in a handbag in a kitchen off a landing and nobody has been in that kitchen. The printed extract from Committee Services went back into a tray in a hall in Tideglass on 30 March 2015 in about four seconds and her name is not on it and there is no name box on it and may not be put on it. **NOTHING IN CHAPTERS 131–140 NAMES HER, REFERENCES HER, OR PUTS HER IN ANY DOCUMENT, AND NOBODY WENT TO THE BOTTOM OF QUARRY STREET, AND NEITHER PIECE OF PAPER WAS OPENED.** **A HOLE IN THE RECORD IS THE ONLY HONEST THING ANYBODY IN THIS BOROUGH HAS PRODUCED ABOUT A PERSON IN NINE MONTHS, AND THE PRICE OF IT IS A PIECE OF A4 IN A DRAWER WITH NO KEY ON IT, AND A WOMAN OF THIRTY-FOUR IS A PERSON THIS BOROUGH CAN SAY NOTHING ABOUT AT ALL, AND THAT IS THE CORRECT OUTCOME.**

- **A MAN OF ABOUT SIXTY WITH A GALVANISED CAN.** Not on any list, never been in that vestibule before, came on 16 March 2015 and asked what was in the trough by the lock-ups on 2 February, and was given the state in about eleven seconds in three halves, and was told she cannot say what was in a trough on a Tuesday in February and there is not going to be a form that can. He said `Then I will not put the drum in`, and went out with the can and the answer. **HE CAME BACK ON 20 APRIL AND ASKED `Is that a receipt`, and was told no, and was told the state cannot be paid, cannot be returned, cannot be filed and cannot be thrown away, and that the last of those is not her doing but the absence of a procedure, and that so it will be in his coat. HE SAID `Then I am sorry I asked`, and she said nobody in this borough has ever said sorry to her at that counter and she would rather he did not make a thing of it. HE PUT IT BACK IN THE INSIDE OF HIS COAT, WHERE IT HAD BEEN, AND THAT WAS THE END OF IT.** Nobody helped him and nobody was harmed. **He is the only other person in this borough who knows what a slip from that counter is, and he does not know, and he is carrying one.**

- **A MAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-FOUR WHO WORKS IN A CANTEEN.** Not on any list. Has been in that corridor twice. Said on 25 March 2015: `Is it true that there's a counter down there that gives you a date.` `Right. Well, it's not strange any more, that's all I wanted.` And: a fella asked me about it in January, worked nights, agency, and he told a woman on our shift and she'd already been told by somebody, and one of the girls works over at the hospital and she's told the whole of that kitchen by now, and they're not making a thing of it, they're just doing it, and there's a girl on our till who's had two of them off a landlord and she's not even surprised, she just said *oh, they all do that now*. **He is one of the three Otieno gave it to, or he is downstream of one of the three, and which it is is not established and nobody is going to establish it, and nobody is going to ask.**

- **A WOMAN OF ABOUT THIRTY WHO ASKED `Is the man who stands at the wall on a list`** at that counter on Friday 24 April 2015 and was told no in about four seconds plus the second half, and said `That's a shame` and went out into the street and did not come back. **She is the first person in nine months to pay the price of 13 March, and she paid it to the counter, and the counter was right, and she will not know who the man is.**

- **EZRA MBEKI, in and out of that building since 1992, and TREVOR NUNN, 58, a night porter, nineteen years, who is not on a roster because the roster does not exist.** **They have read every Saturday-night handover since 3 January 2015 and they have now read fourteen of them and not one has a date on it and there is not going to be one.** Neither is on any instrument. Neither knew until about nine o'clock. It took about nine minutes and then they sat down and went home at about half past six. **NEITHER OF THEM KNOWS THAT A MAN REFUSED OUT LOUD, IN A CORRIDOR, IN DAYLIGHT, ON 2 MARCH 2015, TO BE IN THAT ROOM, AND NEITHER OF THEM IS GOING TO BE TOLD, AND THERE IS NO WAY IN THIS BOROUGH TO TELL THEM, AND THAT IS NOT A FAILURE OF A RECORDS SYSTEM — THERE IS NO RECORDS SYSTEM. # VOLUME 04, BATCH 0002 — CHARACTER STATE AFTER CHAPTER 164 — Friday 26 June 2015

**VOLUME 04 IS NOT CLOSED. IT RUNS TO CHAPTER 192. Nothing below was resolved in Chapters 155–164, nothing was softened, and nothing may be resolved in Batch 0003 by anybody without a line in `state/continuity.md` saying so. There is one of every person in this account and no second of any of them.**

- **JONAS MERCER, 32.** LAST WORKING SYSTEM ADMINISTRATOR, CITY OF NACRE — civic standing, no grade, no department, not subject to review, released by no person. Not a party, not a member, not a departmental officer, and may not become one. **HE ASKED NO QUESTION OF ANYBODY ON ANY OF THE TEN DAYS OF THIS BATCH AND HE HAS NOW ASKED NONE SINCE THE TWENTY-FIFTH OF FEBRUARY 2015. HE WAS ASKED ONE QUESTION IN FOUR WEEKS AND ANSWERED IT, ONCE, IN A CANTEEN AT THE BACK OF THE HOSPITAL SITE ON THURSDAY THE EIGHTEENTH OF JUNE BY SOLOMON ADJEI, 33 — *is there anybody in this city who is allowed to put me in that sentence without writing anything* — AND HE SAID NO, AND GAVE A REASON, AND IT IS THE ONLY ANSWER HE GAVE IN THE BATCH, AND IT IS WORTH NOTHING, AND IT IS CORRECT.** Every other thing he said out loud in ten chapters was said to a wall, or was a reason for a door being put on a list, or was nothing at all. He was in a car park and said nothing. He was in a corridor at a school and said nothing. He was in a church hall for three hours and said nothing. He was at the end of a corridor at about half past eleven on 23 June while a man of thirty-six held the 2011 file in his hands and put it back, **and had about a sentence's worth of bay number and date available to him and said nothing, and the chapter does not say whether that was right and neither does any later chapter.** He was in a room with a printed sheet of nine identical correct answers on the table and said nothing. He was at the back of a shopfront with a bottle of water he had already paid for and did not go out into the road. He was in a small meeting room while a correct request was granted in a sentence and somebody wrote *agreed* and a date on the back of a page, and he left at about half past ten and wrote nothing down. He was in a corridor at about one o'clock and was told in about six words that the round at the end of Collier Lane had moved and there was a man at number thirty-one who filled a butt under a downpipe and that he was sixty, and he said nothing. **HE FOUND OUT THAT HE COULD HAVE FOUND THAT MAN IN ABOUT AN HOUR AND HE DID NOT GO, AND CHAPTER 0163 PUTS THE REASON ON THE PAGE AND THE REASON IS ABOUT HIM AND NOT ABOUT THE MAN: a man of sixty found on a piece of paper is a man who has been found, and a man of thirty-two who carried the fourth container up that lane would have become a sentence about a man of sixty, and a woman of nineteen called that sentence a kindness on a footbridge in this city in May and she was right about the word and the word is the reason he did not do it.** He was not on the agenda of anything, he chaired nothing, there is no chair of that body and there never was, and the board has not met since the middle of January. He performed no edit, attended no duty, signed nothing, and wrote nothing that leaves his pad. **HE IS FOUR HUNDRED YARDS AWAY, ON PURPOSE, AND HE STOPPED COUNTING THE STANDS IN CHAPTER 0147 AND THE COUNT IS CLOSED AT EIGHT.** *Four hundred yards* appears once in these ten chapters, in Chapter 0164, in the standing of the city, and means what it has always meant; at a first pass Chapter 0158 gave it a new use and was corrected. **HE SAID THE PRICE INSTEAD OF A PRINCIPLE OUT LOUD ONCE, TO ONE PERSON, ON THE THIRTEENTH OF APRIL 2015, AND IN CHAPTERS 0158, 0160 AND 0163 HE REFERRED TO IT WITHOUT RESTATING IT AND THAT IS THE ONLY PERMITTED FORM.** He was not thanked for anything in these ten chapters and he thanked nobody and nobody refused to be thanked and no character in any of the ten said out loud that they have not been thanked and are not going to be, and **nobody was refused anything at all in this batch.** He did not open anything, he did not open the drawer, he did not open the file, he did not read the page, he did not ask the man of about forty-five anything, he did not go to Gantry Ward, did not telephone, did not tell Royden Achebe anything, did not ask Peter Naylor anything, did not go and find the man of forty-eight, did not look for the hand that puts the strip in the drawer, did not go to the man who turns the bucket, did not find Colin Wharton, and did not ask anybody anything about a gate, a rota, a compliance paragraph or a person.

- **RONNIE PEART, 52, OF NUMBER FIFTY-EIGHT ON ONE OF THE FOUR STREETS, NINETEEN YEARS, WITH A DOG.** He has no position of any kind in this borough and is on nothing and is not going to be. **He went round nine doors over three evenings, on foot, and asked one question at each of them, and the question was correct, and the answer at all nine was one word, and the word was correct.** He is not a thread, he is not owed anything, he is not going to be thanked, and the envelope with the answers on it is in a drawer in a kitchen in number fifty-eight and nobody has asked him for it and nobody is going to. **HE IS THE PERSON WHO FIRST SAID OUT LOUD THAT NINE LINES IN A ROW IS NOT NINE PEOPLE BUT A STREET WITH A SHAPE, AND THAT ONCE A STREET HAS A SHAPE THERE IS SOMEWHERE YOU CAN POINT.** And he handed the answers back to himself and put them in his pocket, and nothing was helped, and he was right.

On 17 September **Nina Calder told him to open the register, which he has never opened, and he opened it**, and did the sum standing, and got **six hundred and sixty-one**, and put the paper back in his coat, and she said it would be the same in a month and that she has said that to him every month since about February and that neither of them has ever done anything about it. He was out of the building at twenty past eleven and down the parade by twelve. **He is on nothing. **THE WOMAN IN HER LATE TWENTIES.** She has had the same delivery every week for nine years and it came on a Wednesday once in the February and it was gone by the Tuesday, and she opened her door for four days and has said nothing to the man who brings it, and she has settled that she will leave it unmarked. **SHE MAY NOT BE ASKED WHY SHE WILL NOT PUT A NOTE ON HER DOOR, AND THE DELIVERY, THE WEDNESDAY, THE FOUR DAYS AND THE DOOR ARE SPENT AS OBJECTS AND AS A THING.**

**THE MAN IN HIS EARLY THIRTIES.** Six years in the same trade and never once had anywhere else to put his own, and on the second Monday of March what was behind a door he has never locked was not there, and he has told his house, his work and his mother nothing. **HE IS NOT TO BE ASKED WHO HE THINKS TOOK IT, HE IS NOT A WITNESS TO ANYTHING ELSE, HE MAY NOT BE USED A SECOND TIME TO CARRY A DISCLOSURE, AND THE LOCKER, THE BOX, THE SIX YEARS AND THE FITTER ARE SPENT AS OBJECTS AND AS A THING.**

**AND THE FIGURES WHO EXIST ONLY AS WHAT THEY DO.** **THE COLLEAGUE WHO GAVE A NAME IN A CORRIDOR AND WENT ON UP IT · THE WOMAN WHO CROSSED BETWEEN TWO THINGS THAT WERE NOT MOVING · THE YOUNG MAN WHO CAME OUT OF A VEHICLE AND SAID ONE WORD THREE TIMES · THE OTHER SIX ON THE OUTSIDE OF A BUILDING · THE ONE OF THE NINE WHO PUT A NOTE ON A DOOR AND TOOK IT BACK · THE MAN WHO SOLD THE BENCH AND DID NOT ANSWER · THE WOMAN WHO SELLS THE SAME FOUR ON THE WRONG DAY · THE FITTER · THE MAN WHO SAID THE WORD ABOUT THE WEATHER AND DRIVE AWAY · AND THE REST OF THEM. NONE IS AGED, NONE MAY BE NAMED, DESCRIBED OR RETURNED TO, AND NOBODY COUNTS ANY OF THEM.**

THAT IS A FACT AND NOT A DECISION ANYBODY MADE, AND NO WRITER BROUGHT A NAMED FIGURE BACK AND NO REUNION WAS INVENTED.**

**AND ALL SIX OPEN QUESTIONS ARE STILL OPEN AND NONE WAS ANSWERED, AND THE BLOCK ADDED NONE OF ITS OWN.** Four accounts of one occurrence are still in circulation, none of them fits inside any other, nothing new has come along, and nobody has said which of the four is theirs, and 0554 did not carry them.
